feature.access_requests.name: Edit access requests
feature.access_requests.description: Members who can read a page but not edit it ask for edit access; administrators decide.
access_requests.title: Access requests
access_requests.setting: Let people ask for edit access
access_requests.setting_hint: Members who can read a page but not edit it get an “Ask for edit access” button.
access_requests.scope.category: You are asking to edit pages in “{category}”.
access_requests.scope.wiki: You are asking to edit any page in this wiki, not only your own.
access_requests.message_hint: Why you need it, in a few words.
access_requests.sent: Request sent. You will get a notice when an administrator decides.
access_requests.error.cooldown: Your request was declined. You can ask again from {until}.
access_requests.error.off: Asking for edit access is switched off on this wiki.
access_requests.error.not_needed: You can already edit this page, or a request cannot change that.
access_requests.error.message_too_long: The message can be at most {limit} characters.
access_requests.error.already_open: You already asked; an administrator will decide.
access_requests.error.too_many: You can send at most {limit} requests a day.
access_requests.error.missing: This request was already decided or no longer exists.
access_requests.adds.category: Approving adds “{category}” to the categories they can edit in.
access_requests.adds.edit_all: Approving gives them “Edit all pages”, in every category they can edit in.
access_requests.adds.both: Approving adds “{category}” to the categories they can edit in, and gives them “Edit all pages”.
access_requests.adds.nothing: They can already do this: approving changes nothing.
access_requests.flash.approve: Approved: {username} has the access they asked for.
